name: Lomita City Council
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, November 05, 2019 - 06:00 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation – Council Member Waronek
d.
Roll Call
e.
Closed Session Report – City Attorney
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
* SOUTH BAY WORKFORCE INVESTMENT BOARD 4th QUARTER REPORT
Presented by Chris Cagle
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER’S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Council Member or staff.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: That Consent Calendar Items 7 a-i be approved.
a.
Motion to waive full reading of ordinances and that they be read in title only
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve Motion.
b.
Approval of the Minutes of the Regular City Council Meeting of July 16, 2019, Special and Regular City Council Meetings of October 1, 2019, and Regular City Council Meeting of October 15, 2019
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve Minutes.
Item #7b
c.
Approval of Warrants/Payroll Register
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve and file Warrants/Payroll Register.
Item #7c
d.
Approval of Updated Agreement with Liebert Cassidy & Whitmore
RECOMMENDED ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council authorize the Mayor to sign an agreement for employment relations matters with Liebert Cassidy Whitmore.
Item #7d
e.
Approval of a Funds Transfer from the FY 2018-2019 Budget to the FY 2019-2020 Budget for the Payment of a Vehicle for the Water Division
RECOMMENDED ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council authorize the Administrative Services Director to transfer $27,000 from Account No. 520-840-5825 (Water Capital – Equipment Over $5k) from the FY 2018-2019 Budget to the FY 2019-2020 Budget for the payment of a Ford F-150 purchased for the Water Division.
Item #7e
f.
Acceptance of Commissioner Resignation
RECOMMENDED ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council accept the resignation of Yohan Ruparatne from the Parks and Recreation Commission effective October 23, 2019, and authorize the City Clerk to post notice of vacancy, accept applications, and schedule interviews to select a candidate to fill the unexpired portion of the term which ends June 2022.
Item #7f
g.
Approval of a Resolution Authorizing a Grant Application for the California Housing and Community Development SB-2 Planning Grants Program
RECOMMENDED ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution 2019-25 authorizing the application for, and receipt of, SB-2 Planning Grants Program (PGP) funds; and authorize the City Manager to enter into, execute, and deliver a State of California Agreement in the amount of $160,000.
RES 2019-25 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, AUTHORIZING APPLICATION FOR, AND RECEIPT OF, SB-2 PLANNING GRANTS PROGRAM FUNDS
Item #7g
h.
Approval of Final Change Order and Notice of Completion for the Construction of the 253rd Place Area Water Main Replacement Project
RECOMMENDED ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council:
1.
Accept the work performed by Garrett J. Gentry General Engineering, Inc., for the construction of the 253rd Place Area Water Main Replacement Project; and
2.
Authorize an amendment to Agreement No. 2018-23 with Garrett J. Gentry General Engineering increasing the contract budget by $31,984.86 for a total contract amount of $379,181.06; and
3.
Authorize the Public Works Director to sign the Notice of Completion (NOC) and release the 5% retention payment in the amount of $18,959.05 to Garrett J. Gentry General Engineering, Inc., 35 calendar days after recordation of the NOC by the County Recorder’s Office contingent upon no claims being filed on the project and the contractor posting an acceptable warranty bond; and
4.
Authorize the City Clerk to file the NOC with the County Recorder’s Office.
Item #7h
i.
Project Update and Approval of Amendments to Budget and Agreements Related to the Walnut Street Water Main Replacement and Street Rehabilitation Project
RECOMMENDED ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council:
1.
Increase the project budget to $1,905,336.48 and appropriate $18,000 to 207-810-5806.355, and $18,000 to 209-810-5806.355.
2.
Authorize the City Manager to execute Amendment No. 1 to the Professional Services Agreement with NV5, Inc. (CivilSource), in the amount of $11,325; and
3.
Authorize the City Manager to execute Amendment No. 1 to the Professional Services Agreement with LAE Associates, Inc., in the amount of $39,630.
Item #7i
SCHEDULED ITEMS
8.
DISCUSSION AND POSSIBLE CONSIDERATION TO APPROVE AN AGREEMENT WITH TRIPEPI SMITH AND ASSOCIATES TO PROVIDE COMMUNITY ENGAGEMENT AND EDUCATIONAL OUTREACH SUPPORT FOR MATTERS RELATED TO THE CITY’S WATER SYSTEM
Presented by Carla Dillon, Public Works Director
RECOMMENDED ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council: 1) Approve an agreement with Tripepi Smith and Associates (TSA) to provide community engagement and educational outreach support services for matters related to the City’s water system for an amount not to exceed $85,000 for a 12-month period; and 2) Authorize the City Manager and City Clerk to execute the agreement.
Item #8
9.
DISCUSSION AND POSSIBLE CONSIDERATION OF CANCELLING OR RESCHEDULING THE DECEMBER 3, 2019, AND JANUARY 7, 2020, CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS (No staff report)
Presented by Ryan Smoot, City Manager
RECOMMENDED ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council cancel or reschedule the December 3, 2019, and the January 7, 2020, meetings due to the holiday work schedule.
10.
ADJOURNMENT The next regular meeting will be held on Tuesday, November 19, 2019, at 6:00 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, located at 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting at the following locations: Lomita City Hall lobby and outside bulletin board, Lomita Parks and Recreation, and uploaded to the City of Lomita website http://www.lomita.com/cityhall/city_agendas/.
Date Posted: October 31, 2019
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
